consent_intro: This app will record your medical history and scan your old documents so your doctor is ready before you enter. Your information is kept secure.
consent_his: Do you agree to share this history with the doctor?
consent_abha: Do you agree to link your record to your ABHA account? (optional)
consent_storage: May we keep photos of your documents? (otherwise only extracted text is kept)
revoke_consent: Revoke consent and delete my data
confirm_no: No, let me say it again
go_to_room: Please go to the doctor's room
priority_alert_call_nurse: Your symptoms may be serious. Should we alert a nurse?
other_problems_intro: Tell us about any other problems
